acceptanceCriteria: Real isolated add fixtures force git add failure and git commit failure independently and prove nonzero exit without an added-success message or falsely clean/committed status.

Preserve generated charter bytes and unrelated index/worktree changes on failure; provide an idempotent supported exact-byte completion route, avoiding duplicate ticket creation or manual shard edits.
Keep native Core/roadmap lock order and fail-closed authority checks, and verify actual success means the intended owning-shard commit exists.
Integrate the Core-owned minimal repair with relevant focused regressions, required owning gate and independent review; link exact native closure before completing this EXTERNAL Corvint intake.
body:
Confirmed native Core tooling defect observed 2026-09-30 while adding CORE-SAME-OWNER-CLOSED-SESSION-REBIND-1 through supported roadmap.sh add. In the default Codex sandbox, writing the source shard succeeded but git add and git commit each failed creating .git/index.lock with Operation not permitted. The add invocation nevertheless printed added CORE-SAME-OWNER-CLOSED-SESSION-REBIND-1 and returned exit 0. Canonical source function _do_add, script/roadmap.sh:3204-3214, does not explicitly propagate stage/commit failures before its success echo; the surrounding locked function invocation masks reliance on set -e. No direct shard edit or fabricated failure was used.

Observed source version before successful recovery: native source unchanged from Core 5dead47f49f24f56e77c9901d5ff4f86bb2579a5; actual later pre-add main advanced independently, so use bound source SHA rather than infer exact effect-start HEAD. Exact log /tmp/core-same-owner-add.log and generated diff /tmp/core-same-owner-added-shard.diff. Core roadmap.sh SHA256 recorded below. Corvint Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202 is intake transport, not the defective implementation. Corvint received no product mutation other than this intake.

Reproduction: in an isolated repository fixture, permit roadmap source write but inject failure of git add and/or git commit (e.g. test wrapper), invoke the real supported add command, and assert nonzero failure with no success claim. Observed live case used real sandbox Git denial; do not reproduce by damaging real index or locks. Independent stage and commit failures need coverage.

Recovery performed by coordinator authorization: preserve exact generated shard byte SHA, invoke unchanged with_roadmap_commit_locks + _commit_ticket_roadmap_edit under escalation, then verify identical bytes, actual commit 6edd1adab51eb85f6319c070664f542b33d121f6, clean main and unchanged roadmap_pipeline.py. No duplicate add or manual queue edit. This completed the interrupted intake; it is containment, not a fix to _do_add.

Core closure owner: Beamfall Core. Retain owning roadmap ticket, exact repaired source and commit, isolated failing/passing reproduction, focused tests, required owning gate and independent review, integration and native completion evidence before closing this EXTERNAL intake. Adjacent CORE-MULTIREPO-COMPLETION-FENCE-1 includes a different already-staged checkoff recovery defect; this add success-reporting defect has separate trigger and code path. Dedup queries roadmap add, staging failure and false success returned zero matches. Actor authentication, runtime qualification and historical acceptance remain NOT_OBSERVED in Tasks audit.
